column1: # The renderer job's parts (.github/workflows/build.yml), each a process of build/test.py's --layout
# on lavapipe. A line holds a part's number, a test class or one case of a class by its display
# name, and its minutes on the runner, what it took on lavapipe held to four cores here scaled by
# what its part took in the build run of ca8c50b4 against what its lines came to. A class goes whole
# into a part where it fits one and by its cases where it does not. The lines are dealt from the
# longest into ten parts, each to the part holding least, so the parts come out alike, some 32
# minutes each. The part holding * takes every test no other line names, the classes that draw
# nothing, a class or a case added since, and the cases that skip themselves on a device that draws
# on the processor, its minutes theirs.
